notes:
Fantasy theme lost all its invented-world places (Middle-earth, Narnia, Hogwarts, Westeros...); refilled with genre words, public-domain places (Oz, Wonderland, Neverland, Lilliput) and authors. Kept Shangri-La in legendary places (from the 1933 novel Lost Horizon, but now a common noun); remove it if you want to be strict. Removed Brigadoon (1947 musical). Kept Tinker Bell (Barrie, public domain), Sherlock Holmes, The Great Gatsby (US public domain since 2021), Jabberwock/vorpal sword (Carroll), Nicolas Flamel (real person), walking dead and nosferatu (generic). Japanese and yokai names now use Wikipedia's macrons (Momotarō, yūrei, umibōzu); Turkish folklore uses Turkish letters and its flag was updated. Arabian nights marked separate because Baghdad, Basra, caliph, vizier, sultan, bazaar do not read as folklore. Superstitions marked separate (omens and charms, not tales or beings). Revolutions and empires are qualifier-only words (Velvet, Ottoman) so they cannot sit in their parent. The original file is backed up at scratchpad/batch-40.orig.json.
Restored at the owner's request (video games and copyrighted novels allowed): death knight (undead), Tamriel (fantasy), Hyrule (fantasy), Azeroth (fantasy), Krynn (fantasy), Faerun (fantasy), drow (fantasy races), gnoll (fantasy races), treant (fantasy races), dragonborn (fantasy races), tiefling (fantasy races), aasimar (fantasy races), genasi (fantasy races), goliath (fantasy races), firbolg (fantasy races), tabaxi (fantasy races), kenku (fantasy races), aarakocra (fantasy races), tortle (fantasy races), yuan-ti (fantasy races), githyanki (fantasy races), githzerai (fantasy races), warforged (fantasy races), svirfneblin (fantasy races), night elf (fantasy races), tauren (fantasy races), draenei (fantasy races), worgen (fantasy races), Khajiit (fantasy races), Argonian (fantasy races), Dunmer (fantasy races), Altmer (fantasy races), Bosmer (fantasy races), Orsimer (fantasy races), bag of holding (magic items), Hand of Vecna (magic items), deck of many things (magic items), magic missile (wizard words), Spyro (dragons), Bahamut (dragons), Alduin (dragons), Paarthurnax (dragons), Deathwing (dragons)
